name: yanliu-4m-v2
quantization: Per-row symmetric int8 for two-dimensional weights except pos.weight; FP32 row scales and remaining tensors.
license_statement: Mixed public sources; per-source attribution retained in data-recipe.json
data_classification: public Chinese text, grouped held-out split; no private conversations or system learning
attribution: LCCC-base, Wikimedia Chinese Wikipedia 20231101, COIG-CQIA human answers, CLUE TNEWS, NaturalConv and CPED dialogue text; fixed revisions and hashes in data-recipe.json

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: cumulative effective targets including the current update; warmup then cosine to 10% peak LR; peak LR is not scaled with batch size

batching.method: group blocks by non-PAD target span 1..64; shuffle within each group; batch size=floor(position_budget/span); shuffle batches each epoch; crop each batch to its non-PAD span; each block occurs once per complete epoch; development uses the same grouping without shuffling

pretraining.sampling: each paragraph separately; nonoverlapping target chunks, previous token retained at chunk boundary; no cross-line concatenation; PAD0 and UNK1 targets ignored; UNK1 retained in inputs; blocks without known targets omitted
pretraining.limits: stop at first epoch/token/wall-time budget; evaluate after final partial epoch; stop after two consecutive dev CE non-improvements
pretraining.selection_criterion: lowest complete text dev next-character CE; ties keep earlier checkpoint

ranking_finetuning.loss: rankCE + ordinary_text_CE; fixed coefficient 1 for each
ranking_finetuning.ranking_loss: CE(mean_character_logp - direct_word_static_gap * 2 + leader_margin_0.25); gold-set marginal CE
ranking_finetuning.ranking_projection: full-context Transformer and dropout; vocabulary head and log_softmax only at nonzero candidate mask positions; mean logp per candidate
ranking_finetuning.oov_policy: match runtime: ASCII letters or candidates at least context-length neutralize the whole group; skip groups with OOV leader or fewer than two representable candidates; skip groups whose in-shortlist golds are all OOV because their leader-tied language score cannot clear the leader margin; retain the full shortlist and accepted gold identities otherwise; OOV language score equals the differentiable leader language score, leaving static penalties and promotion margin intact
ranking_finetuning.loss_reporting: mean_loss and mean_rank_loss are group-weighted; text_cross_entropy is effective-target-weighted
ranking_finetuning.selection_criterion: actual CLI int8 development group-mean top1; ties choose earliest epoch
ranking_finetuning.learning: system learning disabled; only explicitly supplied training files are read

sources.declared_license: not declared in dataset card; retain original source
sources.citation: Wang et al. (2021), NaturalConv: A Chinese Dialogue Dataset Towards Multi-turn Topic-driven Conversation; https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02548

sources.declared_license: Apache-2.0 repository license; original TV dialogue source retained
sources.citation: Chen et al. (2022), CPED: A Large-Scale Chinese Personalized and Emotional Dialogue Dataset for Conversational AI; text only, no speaker or visual annotations
Wang, Yida et al. (2020), A Large-Scale Chinese Short-Text Conversation Dataset, NLPCC; https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.03946

sources.declared_license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 and GFDL (version not specified in card)
sources.citation: Wikimedia Wikipedia 2023-11-01 Chinese dump; original article id/url/title retained in raw Parquet

sources.declared_license: More Information Needed; no unified license declared; per-row copyright retained in raw JSONL
sources.citation: Bai, Yuelin et al. (2024), COIG-CQIA: Quality is All You Need for Chinese Instruction Fine-tuning; https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.18058
Xu, Liang et al. (2020), CLUE: A Chinese Language Understanding Evaluation Benchmark; https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.05986

rules.normalization: Unicode NFC then OpenCC t2s; preserve Chinese punctuation; dedup canonical applies NFKC; remove segmented-Han spaces, markdown styling, controls; preserve Latin token spaces; join hard wraps between long adjacent prose lines without terminal punctuation
rules.source_groups: whole LCCC conversation canonical hash; Wikipedia page id; CQIA source-domain-namespaced original qid or canonical question hash, all distinct answers kept; TNEWS idx; NaturalConv document_id across distinct dialog_id conversations; CPED TV_ID across distinct Dialogue_ID conversations; split before cleaning and paragraph segmentation; frozen new source assignments in source-groups.json
rules.dialogues: clean/filter each utterance separately; retain order within one conversation, preserve existing ending punctuation, otherwise append Chinese full stop; concatenate only that conversation, then segment at <=384 characters; CPED sort by Utterance_ID; no cross-conversation concatenation
rules.split: BLAKE2b(source NUL split_group) first32bits modulo10000: old sources dev[0,150), holdout[150,300), train otherwise; NaturalConv dev[0,1000), holdout[1000,2000), train otherwise; CPED official train/valid/test files, disjoint TV_ID; hash-shuffled source-stratified character budgets
rules.observed_source_exclusion: NaturalConv document_id 0..6 excluded entirely because source research observed them before split freezing
rules.dedup: global canonical exact paragraphs >=12 characters; for >=64 characters query >=2 shared keys among12 bottom-hash16-character shingles and verify length ratio>=0.9 plus shared4-character-shingle multiset count divided by larger total>=0.9; digit content retained; training processed before heldouts
rules.short_common_language: normalized paragraphs shorter than12 characters retained only in train, at most32 occurrences globally; no short paragraph crosses into heldout
rules.previous_training_overlap: Fresh NaturalConv/CPED dev and holdout paragraphs excluded against recorded previous train.txt using the same exact/near canonical paragraph rules, independently of model/candidate results; no previous-training exclusion for new train or old-source regression splits
rules.filter: no URL/contact/advertising/code-heavy/low-Han (<45% of letters and digits) paragraphs or >=6 repeated-character runs; navigation headings removed; no medical-vocabulary exclusion
rules.eval_exclusion: all public data/eval/*.jsonl plus explicit repeatable --exclude paths: context+gold canonical sequences >=6 characters excluded as substrings from all splits, without model scoring holdout; short common words are not globally forbidden

vocabulary.shared_vocab_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 JSON array, ensure_ascii=false, compact separators comma/colon; exact list order retained
vocabulary.coverage_scope: required counts are vocabulary coverage; train_observed and train_atleast100 counts are frozen training-text frequency coverage, not quality scores

rules.split: inherit each complete source/group document assignment; never reassign cases
rules.lengths: one train slot each for 1,2,3-4,5-8 characters; dev/holdout slot chosen by SHA256
rules.sampling: SHA256(document, paragraph, Han-run offset, slot) fixes cut and length; minimum document-slot hash chooses paragraph/run; independent source-budget hash selects a fixed pool of ceil(1.25 * target) before any pypinyin call; annotate/filter/deduplicate only this pool, retain at most target in original hash order; no adaptive resampling to fill shortfalls
rules.context: document-slot hash requests empty context 25% of the time; otherwise preserve 1..32 preceding paragraph characters including punctuation and earlier turns from that conversation; a target may begin at a Han-run boundary when the paragraph already has context; never cross paragraph/conversation boundaries
rules.pinyin: pypinyin NORMAL strict on each complete contiguous Han run before target slicing; one lowercase ASCII syllable per target character; automatic polyphonic readings are not human gold
rules.dedup: SHA256 of NFKC/casefold/alphanumeric-normalized (input,context,gold), matching the train_ranker input boundary, against recorded existing evaluation and globally across the fixed annotation pools; different substantive contexts of a common word remain eligible
rules.selection: public text only; no CLI calls, model scores, candidate filtering or gold injection into recall
rules.source_groups: source_group/group_id inherit source:split_group (NaturalConv news document; CPED TV series); document_group identifies the concrete conversation/page/question used for per-document slot limits
rules.evaluation: holdout limits select only fresh NaturalConv/CPED; old-source heldouts remain corpus regression data; original spelling and automatic pinyin can be noisy

naturalconv.review: 13 clear issues: 6 near/homophone typos, 2 的/得 errors, 5 expression issues; 2 further suspected issues; 9 conversations affected. Sports 8/12, frequent greetings; no marketing observed.
naturalconv.decision: at most 2M training characters; preserve original wording; spoken-language supplement; no inference of corpus-wide error rate

cped.review: No clear spelling errors or marketing observed in fixed train sample; everyday family/school/work topics. Subtitle segmentation and interrupted speech retained in the original dialogue order.
cped.decision: keep all eligible official training dialogues within 1M-character cap; raw train 790970 characters; no inference that corpus is free of errors

train_only_sample_audit.boundaries: Both reviews use train-only fixed samples. No heldout correction, model/recall filtering, private data or system learning.

recipe_quality_notes.naturalconv: Fixed training-only sample: 12 conversations, 242 utterances, 4503 characters; human review found 13 clear issues (6 near/homophone typos, 2 的/得 errors, 5 expression issues) plus 2 suspected issues, affecting 9 conversations; sports 8/12, frequent greetings, no marketing observed. This sample does not estimate the corpus-wide error rate. Limit to 2M train characters as a small spoken-language supplement; do not correct source text or treat automatic heldout labels as clean human gold. Audit sample: results/retrain-20261021/corpus-naturalconv-training-sample.jsonl, SHA256 e95c8439fc4f6b8bd3cbd2b72b9e31723b787a028421e60f38a92142088d9f82.
recipe_quality_notes.cqia: Only answer_from=human; exclude xhs marketing source. Keep all distinct human answers to the same namespaced question; deduplicate body text after grouping.
recipe_quality_notes.fresh_evaluation: Only NaturalConv and CPED are fresh source holdouts; old sources are regression. Automatic pinyin and original spelling can be noisy; never filter by recall/model results.

quality_and_limits.automatic_pinyin: pypinyin 0.55.0 automatically annotates full contiguous Han runs before target slicing. Polyphonic readings and source spelling may be wrong; these labels are not human gold.
quality_and_limits.fresh_source_evaluation: Only NaturalConv and CPED form the fresh ranking holdout. LCCC, Wikipedia, COIG-CQIA and TNEWS text holdouts are old-source regression data.

cped_independent_holdout_groups.limitation: 750 CPED ranking cases come from only 9 independent TV-series groups; case count is not the number of independent source groups.

quality_and_limits.no_performance_claim: Structural integrity, byte identity, vocabulary coverage and the recorded train-only sample review do not establish runtime candidate quality, linguistic label accuracy or model performance.

corpus_checks.scope: No model or decoder calls. Structural/source/character evidence only; does not establish linguistic accuracy of automatic pinyin.

ranking_checks.linguistic_limit: automatic pypinyin supervision; source typos/polyphonic annotation can be wrong; no model/recall filtering

metrics.scope: Development data used for checkpoint selection; not untouched generalization or natural-user typing accuracy.

definitions.denominator: Every input row, including no recall and gold outside the promoted shortlist; no filtering
definitions.group: Explicit group_id from ranking-dev.jsonl; each group has equal weight and its rows have equal weight inside the group
definitions.source: source_group prefix before colon, checked against the existing bucket prefix
definitions.context: nonempty context versus empty context, checked against existing bucket suffix
definitions.rank: CLI full-input gold match excluding Completion
definitions.rescues_breakages: Top1 transitions for named before/after reports; IDs and ranks retained. Raw CLI metrics rescues/breakages remain static-relative.
definitions.group_buckets: Each present explicit group_id has equal weight, and rows have equal weight inside its group; source-context buckets can contain subsets of a group.
definitions.recall: Full-input non-Completion gold in actual bounded candidate list; missing recall remains in all applicable row/group denominators.

selection.criterion: actual CLI int8 development group-mean top1; ties choose earliest epoch

limitations: Development data selected the checkpoint; this paired dev comparison is not an untouched generalization estimate.
CPED dev has 440 rows from only 5 independent TV-series groups; rows do not provide 440 independent groups.
Original corpus spelling and automatic whole-run pypinyin, including polyphonic readings, can be noisy; rates are not natural-user typing accuracy.
LCCC/wiki/CQIA/TNEWS are regression sources with earlier training exposure possible; NaturalConv/CPED are newly added source groups under recorded corpus exclusions.
No holdout text or scores and no private learning were read. No thresholds or hyperparameters changed.
Only candidate quality is measured; latency, memory, real GNOME interaction and key-to-screen delay are not covered.
Observed regression only; handwritten diagnostics and previously observed Tatoeba test are not new independent generalization evidence.
Tatoeba pinyin is automatic; training overlap cannot be ruled out.
CPU quality runs overlap XPU training; no timing or memory performance conclusions.
No fresh holdout or private learning was read; no desktop interaction.
Tatoeba uses its existing group_id; handwritten datasets use individual diagnostic ids, not independently sampled population groups.

performance.quantiles: Nearest-rank ceil(p*n); all three rounds retained. Empty subsets have n0, null quantiles and zero totals. Timing totals sum the measured action/promotion intervals, excluding warmup/startup.
performance.counter_scope: language_groups counts logical language-score calls; language_candidates counts their known candidates, not uncached token forwards. Different models can have different vocabularies, gates, shortlists and work counts. All/scoring frames and matched-scored/same-known-pool subsets are reported separately. Skipped scoring is not faster inference.
performance.scope: Public real Session edits and Model::promotion process CPU/wall costs. No personal learning, physical keys, IBus, GNOME drawing or key-to-screen timing. OS file cache is uncontrolled.
performance.competition: Run serially after all task-owned training/build/measurement jobs end. The four actual training process/exit records are checked before and after every run; unrelated processes are neither scanned nor stopped.
limitations: Host-specific single-CPU Session replay, not physical-key or key-to-screen timing; OS file cache uncontrolled.
Three fixed rounds and one fixed candidate pool establish this comparison only, not global optimality.

holdout.holdout_rule: All three frozen arms evaluated once, all1750rows included. No choice, threshold, strategy or weight adjustment based on holdout results.

definitions.denominator: All 1750 rows, including no recall; no result-dependent exclusions.
definitions.group: Explicit group_id/source_group: 534 NaturalConv news groups and 9 CPED TV groups; group and within-group row weights are equal.
definitions.static: Derived from the identical static_rank fields in the three raw CLI reports; no fourth CLI invocation.
definitions.paired: Top1/top5/recall rescue and breakage IDs/ranks are relative to each named before/after report; raw CLI metrics remain static-relative.

limitations: Single frozen holdout pass; results do not change the frozen selection, thresholds or weights.
CPED has only 9 independent TV groups; row count is not independent-group count.
Original text and automatic pinyin can be noisy; these rates are not natural-user typing accuracy.
No system learning, tuning, training, performance measurement or real desktop interaction is part of this run.
Protocol integration only; no real desktop keyboard/mouse/Shell rendering or latency conclusion.

decision.rationale: Choose the retrained compact model for offline low-latency CPU use. Its dev top1 is close to installed7M, scoring p95 falls6.47ms to4.15ms. Observed replay top1 falls1380 to1357/2000, so this is an explicit speed/quality tradeoff, not blanket improvement. Large is optional for higher dev/replay top1 at35.70ms p95 and higher RSS; its four-choice contextual fixture fails but a separate eight-choice scenario learns/persists correctly. No product thresholds or weights are altered to fit checks.
decision.holdout_rule: All three frozen arms evaluated once, all1750rows included. No choice, threshold, strategy or weight adjustment based on holdout results.
